home.heroSub.message: Liúhèn is a local-first Android app: note down one real thing that happened today, answer a follow-up question to fill in the details, and grow a searchable map of your work — then turn it into resume bullets, weekly reports, and interview cards in one tap.

home.ctaDownload.context: Primary CTA: download APK from GitHub Releases

home.trust.message: No account · No login · No cloud sync · MIT open source

home.screensAria.context: Aria label for phone screenshots section

home.feature1Body.message: Your notes live on your phone and nowhere else. No account, no login, no cloud — your data is simple enough to take with you anytime.

home.feature2Body.message: A local rule engine asks at most one follow-up a day about what matters most: result, context, action, blocker, or your personal contribution. Diary entries become complete evidence.

home.feature3Body.message: Browse everything by time and tags, with full-text search and 7/30-day filters. Completeness of each piece of evidence is visible at a glance.

home.feature4Body.message: Pick one or more pieces of evidence and generate resume bullets, weekly reports, or interview question cards in one tap.

home.feature5Body.message: Bring your own API key (OpenAI-compatible), stored in isolated local storage. Every outbound request shows a disclosure first and sends only the minimal fields you selected.

home.feature6Body.message: Theme follows the system, updates are checked in-app, no subscriptions, no ads. Software should quietly do its job.

home.step1Body.message: Write down one real thing that happened today.

home.step2Body.message: Answer one follow-up to complete the five elements.

home.step3Body.message: Generate resume bullets, reports, and interview cards when you need them.

home.companionBody.message: Each day you show up, your companion grows: interruptions never roll it back, deletions never regress it. Growth only counts the days you came.

home.philosophy.message: Dripping water pierces stone — wisdom from the ancients.
home.philosophy.context: Philosophy line, typed out with typewriter effect

home.faq1A.message: Only on your phone. There is no cloud component at all — uninstalling sends nothing to any server.

home.faq2Q.message: Do I have to configure AI to use it?

home.faq2A.message: No. Notes, follow-ups, the map, and search all run on a local rule engine. AI generation in the Studio is optional and off by default.

home.faq3Q.message: If I enable AI, what gets sent out?

home.faq3A.message: Only the minimal fields of the evidence you explicitly selected, with an outbound disclosure shown before sending. Your API key stays in isolated local storage and is never echoed back.

home.faq4A.message: An Android APK is available on GitHub Releases; you can also build it yourself (Flutter 3.44+).

home.faq5A.message: Free and MIT licensed. No accounts, subscriptions, in-app purchases, or ads.

home.faq6A.message: Check manually from the About page or automatically at launch; auto-update is optional, and mandatory updates cannot be skipped.
